== Style pass (2026-10-15) ==
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The lead gives 9 March 2002 as Virtual Set 1's tournament-legal date (ref: [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]), but the deck list files decks with legal days from 8 February to 8 March 2002 under this pool. Those decks may belong under [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]; check against the wiki's "legal day" rule.
=== Marginal cuts ===
* The long per-deck paragraph ("X is printed Decipher through Theed Palace (no original (V) cards); the format cell is still this pool by legal day (date)." / "X dests [cards].") is now a Decklists list with the same decks, dates and (V) cards.
* Removed summary sentence: "Game Players Network lists posted from that legal day dest original-era slips such as [[Blaster Rack (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy)]], [[Darth Vader (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy)]], [[Prophetess (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy)]], [[Luke Skywalker (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy)]], and [[BoShek (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy)|Bo Shek (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy)]]." (each card stays in the list against its deck).
* Sources list removed: VirtualCards1.pdf (decipher.com, Wayback 13 August 2005) and VirtualCards1a.pdf (res.starwarsccg.org) are now one ref on the lead; [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]] was already the "vs2002" ref.
